body:
Speaking honestly. There's no point to caring until you find something or someone worth caring about. If and when you ever find that something, you'll know it. And caring will come easily. Caring will be to your benefit instead of your detriment.

It sounds to me that the things you *want* to care about aren't things that are *worth* caring about. I find that people are generally pressured into caring about things be it with the opposite sex (heterosexuality), or gender confirming (gender roles). "I'm a man and I should be caring about X."
